topology.selection_reason: nodes 0 and 1 are adjacent with the minimum non-self NUMA distance (20) and normal free memory (~30GB each); no CPU 0-15 assumption copied from S5000C

candidate_source_identity.call_path: cblas_sgemv -> sgemv_ -> sgemv_thread_n -> gemv_kernel -> GEMV_N -> SGEMV_N -> sgemv_n
candidate_source_identity.kernels: 4-col (16-row) and 2-col (32-row) cross-pipeline; selection via sgemv_n_kernel_mode(m, workers)
candidate_source_identity.build: make TARGET=FT2000 USE_OPENMP=1 NUM_THREADS=<N> (exact flags to be fixed at build time)

isa_audit.reason: the SGEMV-N kernel (gemv_n.S) uses only fp/asimd FMA (fmla), ld1 loads and prfm prefetch, all present in S2500 Features; it does not use asimddp/sha3/sm3/sm4/atomics/fphp which S2500 lacks.
isa_audit.s2500_features: fp asimd evtstrm aes pmull sha1 sha2 crc32 cpuid
isa_audit.build_caveat: the build must NOT select an FT2000P-specific path that requires features absent on S2500 (verified by ISA-only check, no library name/implementer inference).

threads1.cpu: single fixed CPU within node 0 (e.g. cpu 0)

threads16.note: candidate and baseline use the identical policy; not copied from S5000C.
